subject: Re: Quick check — priority and timing before quarter close

Subject: Recap: Redwood + FinApps discovery — next steps

Hi Amit,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Key priorities you shared: lower inference latency for user-facing features, predictable per-token cost, and private deployment options for regulated customers.
- Redwood fit: Dedicated pools for steady throughput, automatic batching to control costs, and Private deployment for regulated flows.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a draft SOW for pilot scope and pricing (attached).
2) You said procurement/IT would want a security questionnaire — I'm attaching our Security FAQ and SOC 2 checklist.
3) Can we target sign-off on a pilot by end of Q2 (June 30)? You mentioned that could align with your FY planning but wanted to confirm.

If that timeline feels tight, tell me where it slips (July, Q3) and we'll adjust cadence.

Attachments: FinApps_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, stub), Redwood_Security_FAQ.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

Thanks — I can jump on a short call with procurement/IT if it helps move things faster.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Just bumping this thread to see if there are any updates from finance/procurement on the pilot approval. I know you mentioned end-of-June as a target — totally understand if that slipped. Quick options:

Amit —

Hope you're doing well. We're closing out Q2 and I wanted to do a quick priority check before the quarter finishes this week. Just two quick questions: 

1) Is the pilot still a priority for FinApps for this quarter, or should we shift to a July/August kickoff?
2) Has finance/procurement given any indication on approval/budget? If there are specific blockers (PO, security paperwork, procurement review), I can help: we have standard templates and can join calls to speed things up.
